data.narrative: The payment gateway successfully processed the refund (ev_09), but the internal system state remains PENDING (ev_08). This failure to update refund status occurred because the incoming refund.processed webhook event failed delivery after 3 attempts due to HTTP 500 internal server errors (ev_05).
